newsitem.title: USA: Montgomery Cty, Md., adopts $2.1 bln budget--paper.
newsitem.headline: Montgomery Cty, Md., adopts $2.1 bln budget--paper.

text.p: The Montgomery County council adopted a $2.1 billion fiscal 1998 budget that increases most agency budgets, raises salaries, and keeps taxes unchanged, the Washington Post reported Thursday.

The budget represents the third consecutive year property taxes remained unchanged, the newspaper said. But fees for trash disposal and recycling will rise by about $10 for the typical homeowner, and water and sewer bills wil go up $14.
The budget includes $958 million for schools, a $43 million rise over last year.
More than $1.7 million was added to begin design work on a new jail in Clarksburg.
The council also delayed about $7 million in capital spending on water and sewer projects it said should be funded with a new fee on developers rather than by ratepayers.
